# Submission artifacts

CodeArena stores execution artifacts in the configured S3-compatible object store. Object-store credentials stay in trusted control-plane services and are never mounted or injected into sandbox containers.

## Generated files

For normal (non-challenge) submissions, user code can opt into artifact capture by creating files directly inside `/workspace/artifacts` (relative path `artifacts/`). The capture step runs only after program execution and before the private sandbox tmpfs is destroyed.

Capture policy:

- only direct regular files under `artifacts/` are eligible;
- nested paths, symlinks, sockets, devices and other special entries are not captured;
- at most 10 files are captured per submission;
- each file is limited to 2 MiB;
- total captured generated bytes are limited to 10 MiB;
- filenames are bounded to 128 characters and control characters are rejected;
- MIME type is inspected from file bytes rather than trusted from the filename;
- PNG, JPEG and PDF signatures are recognized explicitly;
- valid UTF-8 JSON is reported as `application/json`, `.csv` text as `text/csv`, other UTF-8 content as `text/plain`, and unknown binary data as `application/octet-stream`;
- generated artifacts are disabled for challenge submissions so hidden-test execution cannot produce user-visible files.

Artifact capture limits do not change the execution verdict. Files outside policy are skipped and a structured policy event is emitted by the sandbox/worker.

## Downloads

Artifact listing and downloads remain behind the submission/project authorization boundary. Object-store URLs are not disclosed to clients. Downloads are integrity-checked against the persisted SHA-256 metadata and returned as attachments with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and no-store caching.

## Retention

The maintenance worker deletes expired submission artifacts and stale compilation-cache objects in bounded batches. Defaults are configured through:

- `ARTIFACT_RETENTION_DAYS=30`
- `COMPILE_CACHE_RETENTION_DAYS=14`
- `STORAGE_GC_BATCH_SIZE=100`
- `STORAGE_GC_INTERVAL_MS=60000`

Deletion removes object bytes before authoritative metadata so a failed object-store delete remains retryable on a later maintenance tick.
